story_type: sea turtle cut free from a ghost net far offshore
hook: A sea turtle trapped in a drifting net, far out in the Pacific.
narration: This sea turtle was trapped in a tangle of abandoned fishing net, far out in the Pacific.
Lookouts on Coast Guard Cutter Campbell spotted it in May 2018, in the middle of a counter-narcotics patrol.
The cutter sent its interceptor boat, and the crew pulled up right beside the animal.
Lost nets keep drifting and catching animals for years. A turtle wrapped in one can starve or drown.
Leaning over the side, they worked the mesh off its flippers and shell by hand.
[short pause] Then they hauled the net itself into the boat.
outcome: Free of the net, the turtle slipped back under the water and swam off on its own.
title: Sea turtle trapped in a drifting net
description:
Crew members from Coast Guard Cutter Campbell used the cutter's interceptor boat to rescue a sea turtle entangled in abandoned fishing gear in the eastern Pacific Ocean on May 14, 2018, during a counter-narcotics patrol.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Cory Mendenhall, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/601465/coast-guard-crew-rescues-sea-turtle
